sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:44

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:44:1
items.html: These seven times, in their general categories, are four — they are the last five, for then a discernment of a name began in her, as above in the third discernment: For the name Nekeva [female] indicates the secret of the rib that was taken from the Adam of Atzilut, who is ZA, and He built her up into a complete Partzuf face to face with ZA, as stated ahead; and since the beginning of the building came through the hole that was made in the posterior of ZA, she is called by the name Nekeva, as will be said below. Therefore, before she received the form of the rib in its full completeness, which is her first substance, she does not yet rise to a name. And understand this.
